SudoClaude now stays out of your games and only uses memory while you're actually using it.

**Out of the way in games.** While a game is running (Steam, Proton, emulators, or any fullscreen game window), the overlay and its glass layer close, notifications stay quiet, and the voice never loads. Super+Space still works mid-game: it opens the typing box, and once you close it everything goes away again. Add your own apps under `game_apps` in the config if one isn't recognised.

**Typing by default.** Voice mode is now off unless you turn it on, so Super+Space opens a typing box straight away instead of loading speech models. Turning voice on in the app first shows what it costs (memory, GPU memory, a short load) and how to keep it out of the way. When it is on, it starts on demand and leaves after a set time unused ("Leave after unused" in Settings).

**Overlay only while it shows something.** The overlay process quits a few seconds after it has nothing on screen, instead of staying up in the background.

**Fixes.** Esc stops Claude right away. Super+Space opens typing while the voice is paused for low memory. Stop now clears a typing box that was left open.

Install `SudoClaude.flatpak` below over the old one:

```sh
flatpak install --user SudoClaude.flatpak
```
